items.value: continuing adjustment 10-30 min after macro releases; pre-release drift 30 min before
items.detail: Kurov, Sancetta, Strasser, Wolfe (2015 draft; published JFQA 2019) on E-mini S&P 500 (cousin) and 10-year note futures, 30 US announcements. 7 of 18 market-moving announcements show pre-announcement drift starting about 30 min before release (about half of the total move; 64% mean for ES in Table 5). Post-release: 'some evidence of continuing adjustment' in [t+10min, t+30min] (joint test, all 30 announcements). Absorption: mostly within minutes per earlier literature, with some drift to 30 min. Not on NQ/RTY/YM.
items.quote: a joint test of significance of price moves in the [t + 10min, t + 30min] window for all 30 announcements shows some evidence of continuing adjustment.

items.value: pre-announcement drift (ES), 7 of 18 releases
items.detail: Same paper, abstract. Direction-correct drift before release; equity-cousin evidence.
items.quote: For these announcements, prices begin to drift in the “correct” direction about 30 minutes before the announcement time. The pre-announcement drift accounts on average for about half of the total price adjustment.
